    document.getElementById('timeline-cursor').innerText = `Cursor: ${pxToTime(scrollEl.scrollLeft).toFixed(2)}s | Playhead: ${appState.playheadTime.toFixed(2)}s`;
    const px = timeToPx(appState.playheadTime);
    if (px > scrollEl.scrollLeft + scrollEl.clientWidth - 60) scrollEl.scrollLeft = px - scrollEl.clientWidth * 0.4;
    const vHit = findClipAt(appState.timeline.video, appState.playheadTime);
    const aHit = findClipAt(appState.timeline.audio, appState.playheadTime);
    if (vHit || aHit) {
      playheadScanRAF = null;
      playAtTimelinePosition(appState.playheadTime);
      return;
    }
    if (appState.playheadTime >= endLimit) {
      playheadScanRAF = null;
      setBlackout(true, 'Nothing found on the rest of the track.');
      return;
    }
    playheadScanRAF = requestAnimationFrame(step);
  }
  playheadScanRAF = requestAnimationFrame(step);
}
/** The canonical entry point for starting playback from a TIMELINE position
    (used by clicking a clip, clicking the ruler/track, Play from Playhead,
    and the searching scan when it finds something). Finds whatever's
    playable on EACH track at that instant and plays them together — a video
    clip's picture with a separate audio-track clip's sound at the same time,
    aligned to the same moment, rather than only ever one exclusively. When
    both are present the video clip's own embedded audio is muted so the
    audio-track clip provides the sound instead (mirrors the "replace" export
    mode); each stops independently when it reaches its own out point rather
    than being cut short by the other. */
async function playAtTimelinePosition(t) {
  stopPlayheadScan();
  const vClip = findClipAt(appState.timeline.video, t);
  const aClip = findClipAt(appState.timeline.audio, t);

  if (!vClip && !aClip) { scanForwardForContent(); return; }

  clearTrimStop();
  clearSecondaryTrimStop();
  previewVideoClip = vClip;
  previewAudioClip = aClip;
  currentPreviewClip = vClip || aClip;
  previewVideoSourceT0 = null;
  previewAudioSourceT0 = null;

  const labelParts = [];

  if (vClip) {
    ensureVUMeter();
    const vAsset = appState.assets.find(a => a.id === vClip.assetId);
    const vBlob = await getFileFromDB(vClip.assetId);
    if (vBlob) {
      setPlayerSource(vBlob);
      player.playbackRate = vClip.playbackRate || 1;
      player.muted = !!aClip;
      applyClipFilterPreview(vClip);
      setBlackout(false);
      const vSourceT = vClip.sourceIn + (t - vClip.start) * vClip.playbackRate;
      previewVideoSourceT0 = vSourceT;
      player.load();
      player.onloadedmetadata = () => { player.currentTime = vSourceT; player.play().catch(() => {}); };
      trimStopHandler = () => { if (player.currentTime >= vClip.sourceOut) player.pause(); };
      player.addEventListener('timeupdate', trimStopHandler);
      labelParts.push(`🎬 ${vAsset ? vAsset.name : 'video'} [${vSourceT.toFixed(2)}s]`);
    }
  } else {
    player.pause();
    player.muted = true;
    setBlackout(true, 'Audio only');
  }

  if (aClip) {
    ensureVUMeter();
    const aAsset = appState.assets.find(a => a.id === aClip.assetId);
    const aBlob = await getFileFromDB(aClip.assetId);
    if (aBlob) {
      setSecondaryAudioSource(aBlob);
      secondaryAudio.playbackRate = aClip.playbackRate || 1;
      const aSourceT = aClip.sourceIn + (t - aClip.start) * aClip.playbackRate;
      previewAudioSourceT0 = aSourceT;
      secondaryAudio.load();
      secondaryAudio.onloadedmetadata = () => { secondaryAudio.currentTime = aSourceT; secondaryAudio.play().catch(() => {}); };
      secondaryTrimStopHandler = () => { if (secondaryAudio.currentTime >= aClip.sourceOut) secondaryAudio.pause(); };
      secondaryAudio.addEventListener('timeupdate', secondaryTrimStopHandler);
      labelParts.push(`🔊 ${aAsset ? aAsset.name : 'audio'} [${aSourceT.toFixed(2)}s]`);
    }
  } else {
    secondaryAudio.pause();
  }

  document.getElementById('clip-context-label').innerText = labelParts.join('   +   ');
}
/** Keeps the secondary audio roughly aligned with the video as both play —
    HTML media elements don't share a clock, so left alone they'll drift.
    Not sample-accurate (that would need real Web Audio scheduling), but
    close enough for a preview. Corrects on the video's own timeupdate tick
    (~4/sec) and right after a manual seek. */
function resyncSecondaryAudio() {
  if (!previewVideoClip || !previewAudioClip) return;
  if (previewVideoSourceT0 == null || previewAudioSourceT0 == null) return;
  if (secondaryAudio.paused || player.paused) return;
  const timelineElapsed = (player.currentTime - previewVideoSourceT0) / (previewVideoClip.playbackRate || 1);
  const expected = previewAudioSourceT0 + timelineElapsed * (previewAudioClip.playbackRate || 1);
  if (Math.abs(secondaryAudio.currentTime - expected) > 0.15) secondaryAudio.currentTime = Math.max(0, expected);
}
// Native video controls (play/pause/seek) only touch the <video> element by
// default — mirror them onto the secondary audio so pausing or scrubbing the
// video doesn't leave the audio track playing on its own or out of step.
player.addEventListener('play', () => { if (previewAudioClip && secondaryAudio.paused) secondaryAudio.play().catch(() => {}); });
player.addEventListener('pause', () => { if (previewAudioClip) secondaryAudio.pause(); });
player.addEventListener('seeked', resyncSecondaryAudio);
function addMarkerAtPlayhead() {
  appState.markers.push({ id: Date.now() + Math.random(), time: appState.playheadTime, label: '', color: '#f59e0b' });
  renderMarkers();
}
function fmtChapterTime(t) {
  const h = Math.floor(t / 3600), m = Math.floor((t % 3600) / 60), s = Math.floor(t % 60);
  return h > 0 ? `${h}:${String(m).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}` : `${m}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}
/** Formats markers as a YouTube-style chapter list and copies it to the
    clipboard. YouTube requires the first line to start at 0:00 to recognize
    chapters at all — if your first marker isn't there, add one before using this. */
function copyChapterList() {
  if (appState.markers.length === 0) { alert('No markers yet — add some with 🚩 Add Marker.'); return; }
  const sorted = appState.markers.slice().sort((a, b) => a.time - b.time);
  const text = sorted.map((m, i) => `${fmtChapterTime(m.time)} ${m.label || 'Marker ' + (i + 1)}`).join('\n');
  const done = () => alert('Chapter list copied to clipboard:\n\n' + text);
  if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(done).catch(() => prompt('Copy this chapter list:', text));
  } else {
    prompt('Copy this chapter list:', text);
  }
}

/* =========================================================================
   TITLES — timed text overlays, live-previewed here and burned in with
   ffmpeg's drawtext at export (see applyTitlesPass).
   ========================================================================= */
function addTitle() {
  const text = document.getElementById('titleTextInput').value.trim();
  if (!text) { alert('Enter some text first.'); return; }
  const start = parseFloat(document.getElementById('titleStartInput').value) || 0;
  const end = parseFloat(document.getElementById('titleEndInput').value) || (start + 3);
  if (end <= start) { alert('End must be after start.'); return; }
  appState.titles.push({
    id: Date.now() + Math.random(), text, start, end,
    position: document.getElementById('titlePositionInput').value,
    fontSize: parseInt(document.getElementById('titleSizeInput').value) || 36,
    color: document.getElementById('titleColorInput').value
  });
  document.getElementById('titleTextInput').value = '';
  renderTitleList();
}
function deleteTitle(id) {
  appState.titles = appState.titles.filter(t => t.id !== id);
  renderTitleList();
}
function renderTitleList() {
  const list = document.getElementById('titleList');
  if (!list) return;
  list.innerHTML = '';
  if (appState.titles.length === 0) { list.innerHTML = '<p class="empty-note">No titles yet.</p>'; return; }
  appState.titles.slice().sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start).forEach(t => {
    const card = document.createElement('div'); card.className = 'preset-card';
    card.innerHTML = `<div class="preset-head"><strong>${escapeHtml(t.text)}</strong><span class="chip">${t.start.toFixed(1)}s–${t.end.toFixed(1)}s · ${t.position}</span></div>`;
    const delBtn = document.createElement('button'); delBtn.className = 'btn btn-danger'; delBtn.innerText = 'Delete';
    delBtn.onclick = () => deleteTitle(t.id);
    card.appendChild(delBtn);
    list.appendChild(card);
  });
}
/** Shows whichever title (if any) covers the given TIMELINE second, matching
    what applyTitlesPass will burn in at export (same gaps-not-modeled caveat). */
function updateTitleOverlay(timelineSeconds) {
  const overlay = document.getElementById('titleOverlay');
  if (!overlay) return;
  const active = appState.titles.find(t => timelineSeconds >= t.start && timelineSeconds <= t.end);
  if (!active) { overlay.innerHTML = ''; return; }
  const topStyle = active.position === 'top' ? 'top: 6%;' : active.position === 'bottom' ? 'bottom: 6%;' : 'top: 46%;';
  overlay.style.cssText = topStyle;
  overlay.innerHTML = `<span style="font-size:${Math.max(12, (active.fontSize || 36) * 0.5)}px; color:${active.color || '#fff'};">${active.text.replace(/</g, '&lt;')}</span>`;
}

function renderMarkers() {
  invalidateStoryboardScale(); // markers are part of the storyboard's key-point set; several callers here skip renderTimeline
  const ruler = document.getElementById('timeRuler');
  const vTrack = document.getElementById('video-track');
  const aTrack = document.getElementById('audio-track');
  if (!ruler) return;
  ruler.querySelectorAll('.marker-flag, .region-band').forEach(n => n.remove());
  [vTrack, aTrack].forEach(t => t && t.querySelectorAll('.marker-line, .region-overlay').forEach(n => n.remove()));

  // Region bands first, so marker flags/lines paint on top of them.
  const regionGroups = new Map();
  appState.markers.forEach(m => { if (m.regionId) { if (!regionGroups.has(m.regionId)) regionGroups.set(m.regionId, []); regionGroups.get(m.regionId).push(m); } });
  regionGroups.forEach(members => {
    if (members.length < 2) return;
    const times = members.map(m => m.time).sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const x1 = timeToPx(times[0]), x2 = timeToPx(times[times.length - 1]);
    const color = members[0].color || '#f59e0b';
    const band = document.createElement('div');
    band.className = 'region-band';
    band.style.left = x1 + 'px'; band.style.width = Math.max(1, x2 - x1) + 'px';
    band.style.background = color;
    ruler.appendChild(band);
    [vTrack, aTrack].forEach(t => {
      if (!t) return;
      const overlay = document.createElement('div');
      overlay.className = 'region-overlay';
      overlay.style.left = x1 + 'px'; overlay.style.width = Math.max(1, x2 - x1) + 'px';
      overlay.style.background = color;
      t.appendChild(overlay);
    });
  });

  appState.markers.forEach(marker => {
    const color = marker.color || '#f59e0b';
    const px = timeToPx(marker.time);
    const flag = document.createElement('div');
    flag.className = 'marker-flag';
    flag.style.left = px + 'px';
    flag.style.background = color;
    if (marker.label) flag.title = marker.label; // hover tooltip only when there's actually a label
    attachMarkerDragHandlers(flag, marker);
    ruler.appendChild(flag);
    [vTrack, aTrack].forEach(t => {
      if (!t) return;
      const line = document.createElement('div');
      line.className = 'marker-line';
      line.style.left = px + 'px';
      line.style.background = color;
      t.appendChild(line);
    });
  });
}
/** Click a marker flag: opens the edit popup (label/color/delete), as
    before. Drag it: leaves the original marker in place and drops an
    identical new one at the release point, linked as a colored region
    between them — a lightweight way to mark a span for later use. */
function attachMarkerDragHandlers(flag, marker) {
  flag.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    e.preventDefault();
    const startClientX = e.clientX;
    const ruler = document.getElementById('timeRuler');
    let dragged = false;
    let previewEl = null;
    function onMove(ev) {
      if (Math.abs(ev.clientX - startClientX) <= 3 && !dragged) return;
      if (!dragged) {
        dragged = true;
        previewEl = document.createElement('div');
        previewEl.className = 'region-band';
        previewEl.style.background = marker.color || '#f59e0b';
        previewEl.style.opacity = '0.6';
        ruler.appendChild(previewEl);
      }
      const t = xToTime(ev.clientX);
      const x1 = timeToPx(marker.time), x2 = timeToPx(t);
      previewEl.style.left = Math.min(x1, x2) + 'px';
      previewEl.style.width = Math.max(1, Math.abs(x2 - x1)) + 'px';
    }
    function onUp(ev) {
      document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
      document.removeEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
      if (previewEl) previewEl.remove();
      if (dragged) {
        saveState();
        const regionId = marker.regionId || (Date.now() + Math.random());
        marker.regionId = regionId;
        appState.markers.push({ id: Date.now() + Math.random(), time: Math.max(0, xToTime(ev.clientX)), label: '', color: marker.color || '#f59e0b', regionId });
        renderMarkers();
      } else {
        openMarkerEditPopup(marker);
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
  });
}
let editingMarkerId = null;
/** Click a marker flag to open this: change its (optional) label and color,
    or delete it. Also moves the playhead there for convenience. */
function openMarkerEditPopup(marker) {
  editingMarkerId = marker.id;
  setPlayhead(marker.time);
  document.getElementById('markerEditLabel').value = marker.label || '';
  document.getElementById('markerEditColor').value = marker.color || '#f59e0b';
  const isRegionEnd = !!marker.regionId;
  document.getElementById('markerRegionNote').style.display = isRegionEnd ? 'block' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('deleteRegionBtn').classList.toggle('hidden', !isRegionEnd);
  openModal('markerEditModal');
}
function saveMarkerEdit() {
  const marker = appState.markers.find(m => m.id === editingMarkerId);
  if (marker) {
    marker.label = document.getElementById('markerEditLabel').value.trim();
    marker.color = document.getElementById('markerEditColor').value;
  }
  closeModal('markerEditModal');
  renderMarkers();
}
/** Removes just this one marker. If it was one end of a region, the region
    (colored band) goes away, but the OTHER end stays behind as an ordinary,
    unpaired marker rather than also being deleted. */
function deleteMarkerEdit() {
  const marker = appState.markers.find(m => m.id === editingMarkerId);
  if (marker && marker.regionId) {
    appState.markers.forEach(other => { if (other.id !== marker.id && other.regionId === marker.regionId) other.regionId = null; });
  }
  appState.markers = appState.markers.filter(m => m.id !== editingMarkerId);
  closeModal('markerEditModal');
  renderMarkers();
}
/** Removes BOTH markers that make up this region. */
function deleteRegionEdit() {
  const marker = appState.markers.find(m => m.id === editingMarkerId);
  if (!marker || !marker.regionId) return;
  appState.markers = appState.markers.filter(m => m.regionId !== marker.regionId);
  closeModal('markerEditModal');
  renderMarkers();
}

/* =========================================================================
   SCOPE SELECTOR — decides which clips a Quick Edit / Preset run applies to
   ========================================================================= */
function onScopeChange() {
  const scope = document.getElementById('scopeSelect').value;
  document.getElementById('scopeRangeInputs').classList.toggle('hidden', scope !== 'range');
  updateScopeHint();
}
function updateScopeHint() {
  const scope = document.getElementById('scopeSelect').value;
  const hints = {
    clip: 'Runs on just the clip selected on the timeline.',
    range: "Runs on every clip that overlaps the range below, on the selected clip's track. Those clips are re-packed back-to-back afterward.",
    track: "Runs on every clip on the selected clip's track. The whole track is re-packed back-to-back afterward.",
    project: 'Runs on every clip on both tracks. Both tracks are re-packed back-to-back afterward.'
  };
  document.getElementById('scopeHint').innerText = hints[scope];
}
/** Returns { video: [clips...], audio: [clips...] } for the current scope. */
function getScopeClips() {
  const scope = document.getElementById('scopeSelect').value;
  const selType = appState.selectedClipType;
  if (scope === 'clip') {
    const c = getSelectedClip();
    if (!c) return null;
    return selType === 'video' ? { video: [c], audio: [] } : { video: [], audio: [c] };
  }
  if (scope === 'project') {
    return { video: appState.timeline.video.slice(), audio: appState.timeline.audio.slice() };
  }
  // 'range' and 'track' both operate on the selected clip's track
  if (!selType) return null;
  const track = selType === 'video' ? appState.timeline.video : appState.timeline.audio;
  let clips = track.slice();
  if (scope === 'range') {
    const rStart = parseFloat(document.getElementById('scopeRangeStart').value) || 0;
    const rEnd = parseFloat(document.getElementById('scopeRangeEnd').value) || 0;
    clips = clips.filter(c => c.start < rEnd && (c.start + clipDuration(c)) > rStart);
  }
  return selType === 'video' ? { video: clips, audio: [] } : { video: [], audio: clips };
}

/* =========================================================================
   STEP LIBRARY — schema + defaults for each Quick Edit step type
   ========================================================================= */
const STEP_LIBRARY = {
  removeSilence: {
    label: 'Remove Quiet Parts',
    fields: [
      { key: 'thresholdDb', label: 'Quiet threshold (dB, lower = stricter)', type: 'number', step: 1, default: -40 },
      { key: 'minSilenceLen', label: 'Ignore quiet spans shorter than (s) — e.g. a 1s "um"', type: 'number', step: 0.1, default: 1.0 },
      { key: 'maxQuietRemaining', label: 'Keep up to this much quiet per cut (s)', type: 'number', step: 0.1, default: 0.4 }
    ]
  },
  speedUp: {
    label: 'Speed Up',
    fields: [
      { key: 'rate', label: 'Playback rate multiplier', type: 'number', step: 0.05, default: 1.3, min: 0.1 }
    ]
  },
  normalizeAudio: {
    label: 'Normalize Volume',
    fields: [
      { key: 'targetLevel', label: 'Target level (0–1)', type: 'number', step: 0.05, default: 0.7, min: 0, max: 1 },
      { key: 'mode', label: 'Mode', type: 'select', options: ['proportional', 'fixed'], default: 'proportional' },
      { key: 'intensity', label: 'Intensity (0–1, how far to move toward target)', type: 'number', step: 0.05, default: 0.6, min: 0, max: 1 }
    ]
  }
};
function defaultParamsFor(type) {
  const out = {};
  STEP_LIBRARY[type].fields.forEach(f => out[f.key] = f.default);
  return out;
}
function renderParamFields(type, params, container) {
  container.innerHTML = '';
  STEP_LIBRARY[type].fields.forEach(f => {
    const wrap = document.createElement('div'); wrap.className = 'field';
    const label = document.createElement('label'); label.innerText = f.label; wrap.appendChild(label);
    let input;
    if (f.type === 'select') {
      input = document.createElement('select');
      f.options.forEach(o => { const opt = document.createElement('option'); opt.value = o; opt.innerText = o; if (params[f.key] === o) opt.selected = true; input.appendChild(opt); });
    } else {
      input = document.createElement('input'); input.type = 'number'; input.step = f.step || 'any';
      if (f.min !== undefined) input.min = f.min; if (f.max !== undefined) input.max = f.max;
      input.value = params[f.key];
    }
    input.dataset.key = f.key;
    input.oninput = () => { params[f.key] = f.type === 'select' ? input.value : parseFloat(input.value); };
    wrap.appendChild(input);
    container.appendChild(wrap);
  });
}

/* =========================================================================
   SILENCE DETECTION — real analysis of the source audio via Web Audio API
   ========================================================================= */
async function detectQuietSegments(assetId, sourceIn, sourceOut, thresholdDb, minSilenceLen) {
  const blob = await getFileFromDB(assetId);
  const arrayBuffer = await blob.arrayBuffer();
  const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
  const ctx = new AudioCtx();
  let audioBuffer;
  try { audioBuffer = await ctx.decodeAudioData(arrayBuffer.slice(0)); }
  finally { /* ctx closed below */ }
  const data = audioBuffer.getChannelData(0);
  const sampleRate = audioBuffer.sampleRate;
  const windowSize = Math.max(1, Math.floor(sampleRate * 0.05)); // 50ms windows
  const startSample = Math.max(0, Math.floor(sourceIn * sampleRate));
  const endSample = Math.min(data.length, Math.floor(sourceOut * sampleRate));
  const thresholdAmp = Math.pow(10, thresholdDb / 20);
  const segments = [];
  let curStart = null;
  for (let i = startSample; i < endSample; i += windowSize) {
    const upper = Math.min(i + windowSize, endSample);
    let sum = 0;
    for (let j = i; j < upper; j++) sum += data[j] * data[j];
    const rms = Math.sqrt(sum / Math.max(1, upper - i));
    const t = i / sampleRate;
    if (rms < thresholdAmp) { if (curStart === null) curStart = t; }
    else { if (curStart !== null) { segments.push({ start: curStart, end: t }); curStart = null; } }
  }
  if (curStart !== null) segments.push({ start: curStart, end: endSample / sampleRate });
  ctx.close();
  return segments.filter(s => (s.end - s.start) >= minSilenceLen);
}

/* =========================================================================
   CLIP AUDIO VISUALIZATION — waveform / volume-bar / spectrogram overlays
   drawn on audio-track clips. The whole asset is decoded and cached once
   (mono-mixed); each clip then slices out just its own [sourceIn, sourceOut]
   from that cache, so scrubbing/zooming/splitting stays fast after the
   first decode.
   ========================================================================= */
const assetPCMCache = new Map();   // assetId -> Promise<{ data: Float32Array, sampleRate }>
const visDataCache = new Map();    // "clipId:mode:width" -> analysis result

async function getAssetPCM(assetId) {
  if (assetPCMCache.has(assetId)) return assetPCMCache.get(assetId);
  const promise = (async () => {
    const blob = await getFileFromDB(assetId);
    const arrayBuffer = await blob.arrayBuffer();
    const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
    const ctx = new AudioCtx();
    const audioBuffer = await ctx.decodeAudioData(arrayBuffer.slice(0));
    let data;
    if (audioBuffer.numberOfChannels > 1) {
      const chL = audioBuffer.getChannelData(0), chR = audioBuffer.getChannelData(1);
      data = new Float32Array(chL.length);
      for (let i = 0; i < chL.length; i++) data[i] = (chL[i] + chR[i]) / 2;
    } else {
      data = audioBuffer.getChannelData(0).slice();
    }
    const sampleRate = audioBuffer.sampleRate;
    ctx.close();
    return { data, sampleRate };
  })();
  assetPCMCache.set(assetId, promise);
  return promise;
}

/** Minimal in-place iterative radix-2 Cooley-Tukey FFT (power-of-2 sizes only). */
function fftInPlace(re, im) {
  const n = re.length;
  for (let i = 1, j = 0; i < n; i++) {
    let bit = n >> 1;
    for (; j & bit; bit >>= 1) j ^= bit;
    j ^= bit;
    if (i < j) { [re[i], re[j]] = [re[j], re[i]]; [im[i], im[j]] = [im[j], im[i]]; }
  }
  for (let len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
    const ang = -2 * Math.PI / len;
    const wRe = Math.cos(ang), wIm = Math.sin(ang);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
      let curRe = 1, curIm = 0;
      const half = len / 2;
      for (let j = 0; j < half; j++) {
        const uRe = re[i + j], uIm = im[i + j];
        const vRe = re[i + j + half] * curRe - im[i + j + half] * curIm;
        const vIm = re[i + j + half] * curIm + im[i + j + half] * curRe;
        re[i + j] = uRe + vRe; im[i + j] = uIm + vIm;
        re[i + j + half] = uRe - vRe; im[i + j + half] = uIm - vIm;
        const nextRe = curRe * wRe - curIm * wIm;
        const nextIm = curRe * wIm + curIm * wRe;
        curRe = nextRe; curIm = nextIm;
      }
    }
  }
}
/** Dark-navy → accent-blue → amber heatmap, used for the spectrogram. */
function heatColor(t) {
  const stops = [[15, 15, 30], [59, 130, 246], [245, 158, 11]];
  const seg = t < 0.5 ? 0 : 1;
  const localT = t < 0.5 ? t / 0.5 : (t - 0.5) / 0.5;
  const a = stops[seg], b = stops[seg + 1];
  return [
    Math.round(a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * localT),
    Math.round(a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * localT),
    Math.round(a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * localT)
  ];
}
async function computeClipVis(clip, widthPx, mode) {
  const key = `${clip.id}:${mode}:${widthPx}`;
  if (visDataCache.has(key)) return visDataCache.get(key);
  let pcm;
  try { pcm = await getAssetPCM(clip.assetId); } catch (e) { return null; } // e.g. a video asset with no audio
  const { data, sampleRate } = pcm;
  const startSample = Math.max(0, Math.floor(clip.sourceIn * sampleRate));
  const endSample = Math.min(data.length, Math.floor(clip.sourceOut * sampleRate));
  const span = Math.max(1, endSample - startSample);
  const w = Math.max(1, Math.round(widthPx));
  let result = null;

  if (mode === 'waveform') {
    const bars = new Float32Array(w * 2);
    const samplesPerPx = span / w;
    for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) {
      const s0 = startSample + Math.floor(x * samplesPerPx);
      const s1 = startSample + Math.floor((x + 1) * samplesPerPx);
      let mn = 0, mx = 0;
      for (let i = s0; i < Math.min(s1, endSample); i++) { const v = data[i]; if (v < mn) mn = v; if (v > mx) mx = v; }
      bars[x * 2] = mn; bars[x * 2 + 1] = mx;
    }
    result = { type: 'waveform', bars };

  } else if (mode === 'volume') {
    const barWidthPx = 5, gapPx = 2, step = barWidthPx + gapPx;
    const barCount = Math.max(1, Math.floor(w / step));
    const samplesPerBar = span / barCount;
    const rms = new Float32Array(barCount);
    for (let b = 0; b < barCount; b++) {
      const s0 = startSample + Math.floor(b * samplesPerBar), s1 = startSample + Math.floor((b + 1) * samplesPerBar);
      let sum = 0, count = 0;
      for (let i = s0; i < Math.min(s1, endSample); i++) { sum += data[i] * data[i]; count++; }
      rms[b] = count ? Math.sqrt(sum / count) : 0;
    }
    result = { type: 'volume', barWidthPx, gapPx, rms };

  } else if (mode === 'frequency') {
    const fftSize = 256, half = fftSize / 2, freqBins = 32;
    const cols = Math.max(1, Math.min(w, 400)); // capped independent of on-screen width for performance
    const edges = [];
    for (let i = 0; i <= freqBins; i++) edges.push(Math.max(1, Math.round(Math.pow(half, i / freqBins))));
    const win = new Float32Array(fftSize);
    for (let i = 0; i < fftSize; i++) win[i] = 0.5 - 0.5 * Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * i / (fftSize - 1)); // Hann window
    const re = new Float32Array(fftSize), im = new Float32Array(fftSize);
    const img = new Uint8ClampedArray(cols * freqBins * 4);
    for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
      const center = startSample + Math.floor((c + 0.5) / cols * span);
      for (let i = 0; i < fftSize; i++) {
        const si = center - fftSize / 2 + i;
        re[i] = (si >= 0 && si < data.length ? data[si] : 0) * win[i];
        im[i] = 0;
      }
      fftInPlace(re, im);
      for (let b = 0; b < freqBins; b++) {
        let sum = 0, cnt = 0;
        const lo = edges[b], hi = Math.max(lo + 1, edges[b + 1]);
        for (let k = lo; k < hi && k < half; k++) { sum += Math.hypot(re[k], im[k]); cnt++; }
        const mag = cnt ? sum / cnt : 0;
        const db = 20 * Math.log10(mag + 1e-6);
        const norm = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (db + 60) / 60)); // ~-60..0dB -> 0..1
        const row = freqBins - 1 - b; // low frequencies drawn at the bottom
        const [r, g, bl] = heatColor(norm);
        const idx = (row * cols + c) * 4;
        img[idx] = r; img[idx + 1] = g; img[idx + 2] = bl; img[idx + 3] = Math.round(255 * Math.min(1, norm + 0.15));
      }
    }
    result = { type: 'frequency', cols, freqBins, img };
  }
  visDataCache.set(key, result);
  return result;
}
function drawClipVis(canvas, result) {
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const w = canvas.width, h = canvas.height;
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
  if (!result) return;
  if (result.type === 'waveform') {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.85)';
    const mid = h / 2;
    for (let x = 0; x < result.bars.length / 2; x++) {
      const mn = result.bars[x * 2], mx = result.bars[x * 2 + 1];
      const y0 = mid - mx * mid * 0.9, y1 = mid - mn * mid * 0.9;
      ctx.fillRect(x, Math.min(y0, y1), 1, Math.max(1, Math.abs(y1 - y0)));
    }
  } else if (result.type === 'volume') {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)';
    const step = result.barWidthPx + result.gapPx;
    for (let b = 0; b < result.rms.length; b++) {
      const barH = Math.max(2, Math.min(h, result.rms[b] * h * 1.6));
      ctx.fillRect(b * step, h - barH, result.barWidthPx, barH);
    }
  } else if (result.type === 'frequency') {
    const off = document.createElement('canvas');
    off.width = result.cols; off.height = result.freqBins;
    off.getContext('2d').putImageData(new ImageData(result.img, result.cols, result.freqBins), 0, 0);
    ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
    ctx.drawImage(off, 0, 0, w, h);
  }
}

/* =========================================================================
   VIDEO THUMBNAILS — a filmstrip of sampled frames per video clip, plus a
   single poster frame per video asset for the left-hand asset list. Both
   share the same "seek a hidden <video>, draw it to a canvas" technique.
   ========================================================================= */
function seekTo(vid, t) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const onSeeked = () => { vid.removeEventListener('seeked', onSeeked); resolve(); };
    vid.addEventListener('seeked', onSeeked);
    vid.currentTime = Math.max(0, t);
  });
}
async function loadHiddenVideo(assetId) {
  const blob = await getFileFromDB(assetId);
  if (!blob) return null;
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const vid = document.createElement('video');
  vid.muted = true; vid.preload = 'auto';
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { vid.onloadeddata = resolve; vid.onerror = reject; vid.src = url; });
  return { vid, url };
}
const videoThumbCache = new Map(); // "clipId:width" -> Promise<{canvas}>
async function computeVideoFilmstrip(clip, widthPx) {
  const key = `${clip.id}:${widthPx}`;
  if (videoThumbCache.has(key)) return videoThumbCache.get(key);
  const promise = (async () => {
    const asset = appState.assets.find(a => a.id === clip.assetId);
    if (!asset || asset.type !== 'video') return null;
    const loaded = await loadHiddenVideo(clip.assetId).catch(() => null);
    if (!loaded) return null;
    const { vid, url } = loaded;
    const thumbH = 52;
    const thumbW = Math.max(20, Math.round(thumbH * ((vid.videoWidth / vid.videoHeight) || 16 / 9)));
    // Sample enough frames to cover the clip's full width at its NATURAL
    // aspect ratio (capped so very wide/long clips don't trigger hundreds of
    // slow sequential seeks). Frames beyond the cap repeat when drawn rather
    // than stretching — a repeated frame is far less jarring than a visibly
    // squished one.
    const neededForNoRepeat = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(widthPx / thumbW));
    const count = Math.min(neededForNoRepeat, 60);
    const span = clip.sourceOut - clip.sourceIn;
    const frames = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const t = clip.sourceIn + (i + 0.5) / count * span;
      await seekTo(vid, t);
      const fc = document.createElement('canvas');
      fc.width = thumbW; fc.height = thumbH;
      fc.getContext('2d').drawImage(vid, 0, 0, thumbW, thumbH);
      frames.push(fc);
    }
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    return { frames, thumbW, thumbH };
  })();
  videoThumbCache.set(key, promise);
  return promise;
}
/** Tiles the sampled frames across the canvas at their natural width —
    repeating frames as needed to fill the space, never stretching one to
    fit, so thumbnails always stay at the video's real aspect ratio. */
function drawVideoFilmstrip(canvas, result) {
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const w = canvas.width, h = canvas.height;
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
  if (!result || !result.frames.length) return;
  const { frames, thumbW } = result;
  let x = 0, i = 0;
  while (x < w) {
    ctx.drawImage(frames[i % frames.length], x, 0, thumbW, h);
    x += thumbW;
    i++;
  }
}
const assetThumbCache = new Map(); // assetId -> Promise<dataURL|null>
async function getAssetThumbnail(asset) {
  if (asset.type !== 'video') return null;
  if (assetThumbCache.has(asset.id)) return assetThumbCache.get(asset.id);
  const promise = (async () => {
    const loaded = await loadHiddenVideo(asset.id).catch(() => null);
    if (!loaded) return null;
    const { vid, url } = loaded;
    await seekTo(vid, Math.min(1, (asset.duration || 2) * 0.1));
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = 64; canvas.height = 36;
    canvas.getContext('2d').drawImage(vid, 0, 0, 64, 36);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    return canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.72);
  })();
  assetThumbCache.set(asset.id, promise);
  return promise;
}

/* =========================================================================
   STEP ENGINE — computes a proposed new clip list + a human diff, per step,
   for ONE original clip. Returns { clips, diffLines }.
   ========================================================================= */
async function computeRemoveSilenceOne(clip, params) {
  const quiet = await detectQuietSegments(clip.assetId, clip.sourceIn, clip.sourceOut, params.thresholdDb, params.minSilenceLen);
  const cuts = [];
  for (const seg of quiet) {
    const segLen = seg.end - seg.start;
    if (segLen > params.maxQuietRemaining) {
      const pad = params.maxQuietRemaining / 2;
      cuts.push({ start: seg.start + pad, end: seg.end - pad });
    }
  }
  if (cuts.length === 0) return { clips: [clip], diffLines: [] };
  let cursor = clip.sourceIn;
  const keepRanges = [];
  for (const cut of cuts) {
    if (cut.start > cursor) keepRanges.push({ start: cursor, end: cut.start });
    cursor = Math.max(cursor, cut.end);
  }
  if (cursor < clip.sourceOut) keepRanges.push({ start: cursor, end: clip.sourceOut });
  const outClips = [];
  let runningStart = clip.start;
  for (const range of keepRanges) {
    const dur = (range.end - range.start) / clip.playbackRate;
    if (dur <= 0.01) continue;
    outClips.push({ ...clip, id: Date.now() + Math.random(), sourceIn: range.start, sourceOut: range.end, start: runningStart });
    runningStart += dur;
  }
  const totalCutTime = cuts.reduce((s, c) => s + (c.end - c.start), 0);
  const diffLines = totalCutTime > 0 ? [{ type: 'cut', text: `Removed ${cuts.length} quiet segment${cuts.length > 1 ? 's' : ''} totaling ${totalCutTime.toFixed(1)}s of silence` }] : [];
  return { clips: outClips, diffLines };
}
function computeSpeedUpOne(clip, params) {
  const oldDur = clipDuration(clip);
  const newClip = { ...clip, playbackRate: clip.playbackRate * params.rate };
  const saved = oldDur - clipDuration(newClip);
  const diffLines = saved !== 0 ? [{ type: 'speed', text: `Sped up by ${params.rate}x, saving ${saved.toFixed(1)}s` }] : [];
  return { clips: [newClip], diffLines };
}
function computeNormalizeOne(clip, params) {
  const oldVol = clip.volume;
  let newVol = params.mode === 'fixed' ? params.targetLevel : clip.volume + (params.targetLevel - clip.volume) * params.intensity;
  newVol = Math.max(0, newVol);
  const diffLines = Math.abs(newVol - oldVol) > 0.001 ? [{ type: 'volume', text: `Adjusted volume from ${oldVol.toFixed(2)} to ${newVol.toFixed(2)}` }] : [];
  return { clips: [{ ...clip, volume: newVol }], diffLines };
}
async function runStepOne(type, clip, params) {
  if (type === 'removeSilence') return await computeRemoveSilenceOne(clip, params);
  if (type === 'speedUp') return computeSpeedUpOne(clip, params);
  if (type === 'normalizeAudio') return computeNormalizeOne(clip, params);
  return { clips: [clip], diffLines: [] };
}
/** Runs a full step chain against one original clip. */
async function computeChainForOneClip(clip, steps) {
  let current = [clip];
  let diffLines = [];
  for (const step of steps) {
    let nextAll = [];
    for (const c of current) {
      const result = await runStepOne(step.type, c, step.params);
      nextAll = nextAll.concat(result.clips);
      diffLines = diffLines.concat(result.diffLines);
    }
    current = nextAll;
  }
  return { originalClip: clip, newClips: current, diffLines };
}
/** Runs a full step chain against every clip in the current scope. */
async function computeChainForScope(steps) {
  const scopeClips = getScopeClips();
  if (!scopeClips || (scopeClips.video.length === 0 && scopeClips.audio.length === 0)) return null;
  const perTrackLabel = (t) => t === 'video' ? 'video track' : 'audio track';
  const results = { video: [], audio: [] };
  let diffLines = [];
  for (const trackName of ['video', 'audio']) {
    for (const clip of scopeClips[trackName]) {
      const r = await computeChainForOneClip(clip, steps);
      results[trackName].push(r);
      r.diffLines.forEach(d => diffLines.push({ ...d, text: scopeClips.video.length + scopeClips.audio.length > 1 ? `[${perTrackLabel(trackName)}] ${d.text}` : d.text }));
    }
  }
  if (diffLines.length === 0) diffLines = [];
  return { scope: document.getElementById('scopeSelect').value, results, diffLines };
}
/** Commits a computeChainForScope() result into appState.timeline. */
function commitScopeResult(chainResult) {
  saveState();
  for (const trackName of ['video', 'audio']) {
    const perClipResults = chainResult.results[trackName];
    if (perClipResults.length === 0) continue;
    const track = appState.timeline[trackName];
    if (chainResult.scope === 'clip' && perClipResults.length === 1) {
      // preserve gaps elsewhere: ripple only what's after the edited clip
      appState.timeline[trackName] = ripplePack(track, perClipResults[0].originalClip.id, perClipResults[0].newClips);
    } else {
      // multi-clip scope: rebuild this track in original order, substituting
      // processed clips, then tight-pack sequentially.
      const replacements = new Map(perClipResults.map(r => [r.originalClip.id, r.newClips]));
      const rebuilt = [];
      track.slice().sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start).forEach(c => {
        if (replacements.has(c.id)) rebuilt.push(...replacements.get(c.id));
        else rebuilt.push(c);
      });
      let cursor = 0;
      rebuilt.forEach(c => { c.start = cursor; cursor += clipDuration(c); });
      appState.timeline[trackName] = rebuilt;
    }
  }
  appState.selectedClipId = null;
  renderTimeline();
  syncManualPanel();
}

/* Repack a track after ONE clip was replaced by newClips, rippling later
   clips left/right to close or open the resulting gap. */
function ripplePack(track, anchorId, newClips) {
  const idx = track.findIndex(c => c.id === anchorId);
  if (idx === -1) return track.concat(newClips);
  const before = track.slice(0, idx);
  const after = track.slice(idx + 1);
  const oldClip = track[idx];
  const oldEnd = oldClip.start + clipDuration(oldClip);
  const newEnd = newClips.length ? newClips[newClips.length - 1].start + clipDuration(newClips[newClips.length - 1]) : oldClip.start;
  const delta = newEnd - oldEnd;
  const shiftedAfter = after.map(c => ({ ...c, start: Math.max(0, c.start + delta) }));
  return [...before, ...newClips, ...shiftedAfter];
}

/* =========================================================================
   QUICK ACTION MODAL (single-step, ad hoc, respects the scope selector)
   ========================================================================= */
function openQuickActionModal(type) {
  if (!getScopeClips()) { alert('Select a clip on the timeline first (the scope is based on its track).'); return; }
  const params = defaultParamsFor(type);
  document.getElementById('paramModalTitle').innerText = STEP_LIBRARY[type].label;
  renderParamFields(type, params, document.getElementById('paramModalBody'));
  const primaryBtn = document.getElementById('paramModalPrimaryBtn');
  primaryBtn.innerText = 'Run';
  primaryBtn.onclick = async () => {
    primaryBtn.disabled = true; primaryBtn.innerText = 'Analyzing…';
    const result = await computeChainForScope([{ type, params }]);
    primaryBtn.disabled = false; primaryBtn.innerText = 'Run';
    closeModal('paramModal');
    if (!result) return;
    if (document.getElementById('paramModalReview').checked) openReviewModal(result);
    else commitScopeResult(result);
  };
  openModal('paramModal');
}

/* =========================================================================
   PRESET BUILDER
   ========================================================================= */
let presetBuilderSteps = []; // [{type, params}]
function openPresetBuilder(existingPreset) {
  presetBuilderSteps = existingPreset ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(existingPreset.steps)) : [];
  document.getElementById('presetNameInput').value = existingPreset ? existingPreset.name : '';
  document.getElementById('presetReviewCheckbox').checked = existingPreset ? existingPreset.reviewBeforeApply : true;
  document.getElementById('presetBuilderModal').dataset.editingId = existingPreset ? existingPreset.id : '';
  renderPresetBuilderSteps();
  document.getElementById('addStepSelect').value = '';
  openModal('presetBuilderModal');
}
document.getElementById('addStepSelect').addEventListener('change', (e) => {
  const type = e.target.value;
  if (!type) return;
  presetBuilderSteps.push({ type, params: defaultParamsFor(type) });
  e.target.value = '';
  renderPresetBuilderSteps();
});
function renderPresetBuilderSteps() {
  const container = document.getElementById('presetStepsContainer');
  container.innerHTML = '';
  document.getElementById('presetStepsEmptyNote').classList.toggle('hidden', presetBuilderSteps.length > 0);
  presetBuilderSteps.forEach((step, i) => {
    const card = document.createElement('div'); card.className = 'step-card';
    const head = document.createElement('div'); head.className = 'step-head';
    head.innerHTML = `<span>${i + 1}. ${STEP_LIBRARY[step.type].label}</span>`;
    const removeBtn = document.createElement('button'); removeBtn.className = 'btn btn-danger'; removeBtn.innerText = 'Remove';
    removeBtn.onclick = () => { presetBuilderSteps.splice(i, 1); renderPresetBuilderSteps(); };
    head.appendChild(removeBtn);
    card.appendChild(head);
    const fieldsDiv = document.createElement('div');
    renderParamFields(step.type, step.params, fieldsDiv);
    card.appendChild(fieldsDiv);
    container.appendChild(card);
  });
}
function savePreset() {
  const name = document.getElementById('presetNameInput').value.trim();
  if (!name) return alert('Give the preset a name.');
  if (presetBuilderSteps.length === 0) return alert('Add at least one step.');
  saveState();
  const editingId = document.getElementById('presetBuilderModal').dataset.editingId;
  const preset = {
    id: editingId || (Date.now() + Math.random()),
    name,
    reviewBeforeApply: document.getElementById('presetReviewCheckbox').checked,
    steps: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(presetBuilderSteps))
  };
  if (editingId) {
    const idx = appState.presets.findIndex(p => String(p.id) === String(editingId));
    if (idx !== -1) appState.presets[idx] = preset;
  } else {
    appState.presets.push(preset);
  }
  closeModal('presetBuilderModal');
  renderPresetList();
}
function renderPresetList() {
  const list = document.getElementById('presetList');
  list.innerHTML = '';
  if (appState.presets.length === 0) { list.innerHTML = '<p class="empty-note">No presets yet. Build one with "+ New Preset".</p>'; return; }
  appState.presets.forEach(preset => {
    const card = document.createElement('div'); card.className = 'preset-card';
    const head = document.createElement('div'); head.className = 'preset-head';
    head.innerHTML = `<strong>${escapeHtml(preset.name)}</strong> <span class="chip">${preset.reviewBeforeApply ? 'review on' : 'auto-apply'}</span>`;
    card.appendChild(head);
    const stepsLine = document.createElement('div'); stepsLine.className = 'preset-steps';
    stepsLine.innerText = preset.steps.map(s => STEP_LIBRARY[s.type].label).join(' → ');
    card.appendChild(stepsLine);
    const actions = document.createElement('div'); actions.className = 'preset-actions';
    const runBtn = document.createElement('button'); runBtn.className = 'btn btn-primary'; runBtn.innerText = 'Run';
    runBtn.onclick = () => runPreset(preset);
    const editBtn = document.createElement('button'); editBtn.className = 'btn'; editBtn.innerText = 'Edit';
    editBtn.onclick = () => openPresetBuilder(preset);
    const delBtn = document.createElement('button'); delBtn.className = 'btn btn-danger'; delBtn.innerText = 'Delete';
    delBtn.onclick = () => { saveState(); appState.presets = appState.presets.filter(p => p.id !== preset.id); renderPresetList(); };
    actions.appendChild(runBtn); actions.appendChild(editBtn); actions.appendChild(delBtn);
    card.appendChild(actions);
    list.appendChild(card);
  });
}
async function runPreset(preset) {
  if (!getScopeClips()) { alert('Select a clip on the timeline first (the scope is based on its track).'); return; }
  const result = await computeChainForScope(preset.steps);
  if (!result) return;
  if (preset.reviewBeforeApply) openReviewModal(result);
  else commitScopeResult(result);
}

/* =========================================================================
   REVIEW MODAL
   ========================================================================= */
function openReviewModal(result) {
  const list = document.getElementById('reviewDiffList');
  list.innerHTML = '';
  if (result.diffLines.length === 0) {
    list.innerHTML = '<li>No changes were needed — nothing met the thresholds you set.</li>';
  } else {
    result.diffLines.forEach(d => { const li = document.createElement('li'); li.className = `diff-${d.type}`; li.innerText = d.text; list.appendChild(li); });
  }
  const applyBtn = document.getElementById('reviewApplyBtn');
  applyBtn.onclick = () => { closeModal('reviewModal'); commitScopeResult(result); };
  openModal('reviewModal');
}

/* =========================================================================
   MODAL + TAB HELPERS
   ========================================================================= */
function openModal(id) { document.getElementById(id).classList.add('open'); }
function closeModal(id) { document.getElementById(id).classList.remove('open'); }
function switchTab(tabId) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.toggle('active', b.dataset.tab === tabId));
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel').forEach(p => p.classList.toggle('active', p.id === tabId));
}
function togglePanel(id) { document.getElementById(id).classList.toggle('hidden'); }

/* =========================================================================
   WORKSPACE IMPORT / EXPORT
   ========================================================================= */
function exportWorkspace() {
  const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(appState)], { type: 'application/json' });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url; a.download = 'workspace.json'; a.click();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 2000); // give the download a moment to actually start before releasing it
}
function importWorkspace(event) {
  const reader = new FileReader();
  reader.onload = (e) => {
    const loaded = JSON.parse(e.target.result);
    appState = Object.assign({ presets: [], markers: [], titles: [], playheadTime: 0, selectedClipId: null, selectedClipType: null }, loaded);
    renderAssets(); renderTimeline(); renderPresetList(); renderTitleList();
    document.getElementById('idealVolumeSlider').value = appState.settings.idealVolume;
    document.getElementById('idealVolLabel').innerText = appState.settings.idealVolume.toFixed(2);
    updateViewMenuState();
    document.getElementById('zoomSlider').value = appState.settings.zoomLevel;
  };
  reader.readAsText(event.target.files[0]);
}
async function clearWorkspace() {
  if (confirm("Clear all cached files and project?")) {
    const tx = db.transaction([STORE_NAME, META_STORE], "readwrite");
    tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME).clear();
    tx.objectStore(META_STORE).clear();
    tx.oncomplete = () => location.reload();
  }
}

/* =========================================================================
   EXPORT — real rendering via ffmpeg.wasm, entirely client-side.
   Video-track clips keep their own embedded audio (speed/volume applied
   together with the video). If the audio track has any clips, its mixed-
   down audio REPLACES the video track's audio in the final file — the
   common case of a separate narration/music track. With no audio-track
   clips, the video track's own processed audio is used as-is.
   ========================================================================= */
let ffmpegInstance = null;
let lastExportObjectURL = null;
let writtenAssetIds = new Set();

async function getFFmpeg(onLog) {
  if (ffmpegInstance) return ffmpegInstance;
  const { FFmpeg } = FFmpegWASM;
  const ffmpeg = new FFmpeg();
  ffmpeg.on('log', ({ message }) => onLog && onLog(message));
  const baseURL = 'https://unpkg.com/@ffmpeg/core@0.12.10/dist/umd';
  const { toBlobURL } = FFmpegUtil;
  await ffmpeg.load({
    coreURL: await toBlobURL(`${baseURL}/ffmpeg-core.js`, 'text/javascript'),
    wasmURL: await toBlobURL(`${baseURL}/ffmpeg-core.wasm`, 'application/wasm')
  });
  ffmpegInstance = ffmpeg;
  writtenAssetIds = new Set();
  return ffmpeg;
}
async function ensureAssetWritten(ffmpeg, assetId) {
  const fileName = `src_${assetId}`;
  if (writtenAssetIds.has(assetId)) return fileName;
  const blob = await getFileFromDB(assetId);
  const { fetchFile } = FFmpegUtil;
  await ffmpeg.writeFile(fileName, await fetchFile(blob));
  writtenAssetIds.add(assetId);
  return fileName;
}
/** atempo only accepts 0.5–2.0; chain it to cover any speed multiplier. */
function atempoChain(rate) {
  let r = rate > 0 ? rate : 1;
  const filters = [];
  while (r > 2.0) { filters.push('atempo=2.0'); r /= 2.0; }
  while (r < 0.5) { filters.push('atempo=0.5'); r /= 0.5; }
  filters.push(`atempo=${r.toFixed(4)}`);
  return filters.join(',');
}
function hexToFFColor(hex) { return '0x' + String(hex || '#ffffff').replace('#', ''); }
function buildVideoFilters(clip) {
  const parts = [];
  if (clip.playbackRate !== 1) parts.push(`setpts=PTS/${clip.playbackRate}`);
  const hasColor = (clip.brightness ?? 0) !== 0 || (clip.contrast ?? 1) !== 1 || (clip.saturation ?? 1) !== 1;
  if (hasColor) parts.push(`eq=brightness=${clip.brightness ?? 0}:contrast=${clip.contrast ?? 1}:saturation=${clip.saturation ?? 1}`);
  if (clip.chromaKeyEnabled) {
    parts.push(`colorkey=${hexToFFColor(clip.chromaKeyColor)}:${clip.chromaKeySimilarity ?? 0.2}:${clip.chromaKeyBlend ?? 0.1}`);
  }
  return parts;
}
function buildAudioFilters(clip, outDur) {
  const parts = [atempoChain(clip.playbackRate), `volume=${clip.volume}`];
  if (clip.denoiseStrength) parts.push(`afftdn=nr=${clip.denoiseStrength}`);
  if (clip.fadeInSec) parts.push(`afade=t=in:st=0:d=${Math.min(clip.fadeInSec, outDur)}`);
  if (clip.fadeOutSec) {
    const st = Math.max(0, outDur - clip.fadeOutSec);
    parts.push(`afade=t=out:st=${st}:d=${Math.min(clip.fadeOutSec, outDur)}`);
  }
  return parts.join(',');
}
async function renderClipSegment(ffmpeg, clip, index, kind, outLog) {
  const srcFile = await ensureAssetWritten(ffmpeg, clip.assetId);
  const outName = `${kind}seg_${index}.${kind === 'video' ? 'mp4' : 'm4a'}`;
  const dur = clip.sourceOut - clip.sourceIn;
  const outDur = dur / clip.playbackRate;
  const args = ['-ss', String(clip.sourceIn), '-i', srcFile, '-t', String(dur)];
  const af = buildAudioFilters(clip, outDur);
  if (kind === 'video') {
    const vfParts = buildVideoFilters(clip);
    if (vfParts.length) args.push('-vf', vfParts.join(','));
    args.push('-af', af, '-c:v', 'libx264', '-preset', 'ultrafast', '-crf', '23', '-r', '30', '-c:a', 'aac', outName);
  } else {
    args.push('-vn', '-af', af, '-c:a', 'aac', outName);
  }
  outLog(`Rendering ${kind} segment ${index + 1}…`);
  await ffmpeg.exec(args);
  return outName;
}
async function concatSegments(ffmpeg, segmentNames, listFileName, outName, outLog) {
  if (segmentNames.length === 1) return segmentNames[0];
  const list = segmentNames.map(n => `file '${n}'`).join('\n');
  await ffmpeg.writeFile(listFileName, list);
  outLog(`Concatenating ${segmentNames.length} segments…`);
  await ffmpeg.exec(['-f', 'concat', '-safe', '0', '-i', listFileName, '-c', 'copy', outName]);
  return outName;
}
/** Concatenates the video track like concatSegments, but crossfades (video +
    its own audio together) wherever a clip's transitionInSec is set, instead
    of a hard cut. Falls back to a plain concat step-by-step where it isn't,
    so a project with no transitions behaves the same as concatSegments. */
async function concatVideoWithTransitions(ffmpeg, videoClips, segmentNames, outLog) {
  if (segmentNames.length === 1) return segmentNames[0];
  let current = segmentNames[0];
  let currentDuration = clipDuration(videoClips[0]);
  for (let i = 1; i < segmentNames.length; i++) {
    const nextClip = videoClips[i];
    const nextSeg = segmentNames[i];
    const nextDuration = clipDuration(nextClip);
    const wanted = nextClip.transitionInSec || 0;
    // Can't crossfade longer than either side actually is.
    const transitionDur = Math.max(0, Math.min(wanted, currentDuration - 0.05, nextDuration - 0.05));
    const outSegName = `xfade_${i}.mp4`;
    if (transitionDur > 0.05) {
      const offset = Math.max(0, currentDuration - transitionDur);
      outLog(`Crossfading into clip ${i + 1} (${transitionDur.toFixed(2)}s)…`);
      await ffmpeg.exec([
        '-i', current, '-i', nextSeg,
        '-filter_complex',
        `[0:v][1:v]xfade=transition=fade:duration=${transitionDur}:offset=${offset}[v];[0:a][1:a]acrossfade=d=${transitionDur}[a]`,
        '-map', '[v]', '-map', '[a]', '-c:v', 'libx264', '-preset', 'ultrafast', '-crf', '23', '-c:a', 'aac', outSegName
      ]);
      currentDuration = currentDuration + nextDuration - transitionDur;
    } else {
      const listName = `xfconcat_${i}.txt`;
      await ffmpeg.writeFile(listName, `file '${current}'\nfile '${nextSeg}'`);
      await ffmpeg.exec(['-f', 'concat', '-safe', '0', '-i', listName, '-c', 'copy', outSegName]);
      currentDuration = currentDuration + nextDuration;
    }
    current = outSegName;
  }
  return current;
}

/* =========================================================================
   TITLES (drawtext) & LOUDNESS NORMALIZATION — whole-video / whole-audio
   passes applied after concatenation, since both operate in final timeline
   time rather than per-clip. Titles are defined in TIMELINE seconds and
   assume the video track has no gaps (clips concatenate back-to-back
   regardless of where they sat on the timeline) — with gaps, a title's
   on-screen timing can drift from what you see in the editor.
   ========================================================================= */
let robotoFontWritten = false;
async function ensureTitleFont(ffmpeg) {
  if (robotoFontWritten) return 'roboto.ttf';
  const { fetchFile } = FFmpegUtil;
  await ffmpeg.writeFile('roboto.ttf', await fetchFile('https://github.com/google/fonts/raw/main/apache/roboto/Roboto-Bold.ttf'));
  robotoFontWritten = true;
  return 'roboto.ttf';
}
/** ffmpeg drawtext's text= value is single-quoted, so straight quotes are
    swapped for a typographic one rather than escaped — much less fragile
    than trying to escape a quote inside a quoted value. */
function escapeDrawtext(s) {
  return String(s).replace(/\\/g, '\\\\').replace(/:/g, '\\:').replace(/'/g, '\u2019').replace(/%/g, '\\%');
}
async function applyTitlesPass(ffmpeg, videoIn, outLog) {
  if (!appState.titles || appState.titles.length === 0) return videoIn;
  const fontFile = await ensureTitleFont(ffmpeg);
  const yFor = (pos) => pos === 'top' ? '20' : pos === 'bottom' ? 'h-text_h-20' : '(h-text_h)/2';
  const filters = appState.titles.map(t => {
    const text = escapeDrawtext(t.text || '');
    const color = hexToFFColor(t.color || '#ffffff');
    const size = t.fontSize || 36;
    return `drawtext=fontfile=${fontFile}:text='${text}':fontsize=${size}:fontcolor=${color}:x=(w-text_w)/2:y=${yFor(t.position)}:box=1:boxcolor=black@0.5:boxborderw=8:enable='between(t,${t.start},${t.end})'`;
  });
  outLog(`Burning in ${appState.titles.length} title(s)…`);
  const outName = 'video_titled.mp4';
  await ffmpeg.exec(['-i', videoIn, '-vf', filters.join(','), '-c:v', 'libx264', '-preset', 'ultrafast', '-crf', '23', '-c:a', 'copy', outName]);
  return outName;
}
async function applyLoudnorm(ffmpeg, inputPath, hasVideo, outLog) {
  const target = parseFloat(document.getElementById('loudnormTarget').value) || -16;
  outLog(`Normalizing loudness to ${target} LUFS (single-pass)…`);
  const outName = `loudnorm_out.${hasVideo ? 'mp4' : 'm4a'}`;
  const args = ['-i', inputPath, '-af', `loudnorm=I=${target}:TP=-1.5:LRA=11`];
  if (hasVideo) args.push('-c:v', 'copy');
  args.push('-c:a', 'aac', outName);
  await ffmpeg.exec(args);
  return outName;
}
/** Standard two-pass-in-one-command GIF technique: generate an optimized
    color palette from the clip, then re-encode using it — much smaller and
    cleaner than a naive direct GIF conversion. No audio (GIF can't carry it). */
async function convertToGif(ffmpeg, videoIn, maxWidth, fps, outLog) {
  outLog(`Building GIF (max ${maxWidth}px wide, ${fps}fps)…`);
  const filters = `fps=${fps},scale=${maxWidth}:-1:flags=lanczos,split[s0][s1];[s0]palettegen[p];[s1][p]paletteuse`;
  await ffmpeg.exec(['-i', videoIn, '-filter_complex', filters, 'out.gif']);
  return 'out.gif';
}
function preflightExport() {
  const hasVideo = appState.timeline.video.length > 0;
  const hasAudio = appState.timeline.audio.length > 0;
  const enabledVideoCount = appState.timeline.video.filter(c => c.enabled !== false).length;
  const enabledAudioCount = appState.timeline.audio.filter(c => c.enabled !== false).length;
  const effVideo = enabledVideoCount > 0;
  const effAudio = enabledAudioCount > 0;
  const box = document.getElementById('exportPreflight');
  const isolated = window.crossOriginIsolated;
  let notes = '';
  if (!isolated) {
    notes += `<p class="empty-note" style="color: var(--warn-color);">This page isn't cross-origin isolated yet, so export can't run. If you just loaded this page for the first time, coi-serviceworker.js should reload it once automatically — try again after that reload. If it still says this, make sure coi-serviceworker.js is published next to this page's HTML on GitHub Pages.</p>`;
  }
  if (!hasVideo && !hasAudio) {
    notes += '<p class="empty-note">Add at least one clip to a track first.</p>';
  } else if (!effVideo && !effAudio) {
    notes += '<p class="empty-note" style="color: var(--warn-color);">Every clip is toggled off — nothing would be in the export. Right-click a clip and choose Toggle On.</p>';
  } else {
    notes += `<p class="empty-note">Will render ${enabledVideoCount} video-track clip(s)${effAudio ? ` and ${enabledAudioCount} audio-track clip(s) (used as the final audio)` : ''}.</p>`;
    if (appState.titles && appState.titles.length > 0) notes += `<p class="empty-note">Will burn in ${appState.titles.length} title(s) from the Titles tab.</p>`;
    const disabledCount = appState.timeline.video.concat(appState.timeline.audio).filter(c => c.enabled === false).length;
    if (disabledCount > 0) notes += `<p class="empty-note">${disabledCount} toggled-off clip(s) will be skipped.</p>`;
    const transitionCount = appState.timeline.video.filter(c => c.transitionInSec > 0).length;
    if (transitionCount > 0 && effVideo) notes += `<p class="empty-note">Will crossfade at ${transitionCount} clip transition(s).</p>`;
  }
  box.innerHTML = notes;
  document.getElementById('exportAudioModeField').classList.toggle('hidden', !(effVideo && effAudio));
  document.getElementById('gifExportField').classList.toggle('hidden', !effVideo);
  if (!effVideo) { document.getElementById('gifExportEnabled').checked = false; }
  onGifModeChange();
  document.getElementById('exportStartBtn').disabled = !isolated || (!effVideo && !effAudio);
}
/** GIF has no audio track and can't be loudness-normalized, so hide those
    controls while GIF mode is checked rather than leave them inert. */
function onGifModeChange() {
  const gif = document.getElementById('gifExportEnabled').checked;
  document.getElementById('gifOptionsRow').classList.toggle('hidden', !gif);
  document.getElementById('exportAudioModeField').classList.toggle('hidden', gif || !(appState.timeline.video.length > 0 && appState.timeline.audio.length > 0));
  document.getElementById('loudnormEnabled').disabled = gif;
  document.getElementById('loudnormTarget').disabled = gif;
}
function openExportModal() {
  document.getElementById('exportRunning').classList.add('hidden');
  document.getElementById('exportDone').classList.add('hidden');
  document.getElementById('exportLog').innerText = '';
  document.getElementById('exportProgressFill').style.width = '0%';
  preflightExport();
  openModal('exportModal');
}
async function startExport() {
  document.getElementById('exportStartBtn').disabled = true;
  document.getElementById('exportPreflight').classList.add('hidden');
  document.getElementById('exportRunning').classList.remove('hidden');
  const statusLine = document.getElementById('exportStatusLine');
  const logBox = document.getElementById('exportLog');
  const fill = document.getElementById('exportProgressFill');
  const log = (msg) => { logBox.innerText += msg + '\n'; logBox.scrollTop = logBox.scrollHeight; };

  try {
    statusLine.innerText = 'Loading FFmpeg (first time only, ~30MB)…';
    const ffmpeg = await getFFmpeg(log);
    ffmpeg.on('progress', ({ progress }) => { fill.style.width = `${Math.min(100, Math.max(0, progress * 100))}%`; });

    const videoClips = appState.timeline.video.filter(c => c.enabled !== false).sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start);
    const audioClips = appState.timeline.audio.filter(c => c.enabled !== false).sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start);

    statusLine.innerText = 'Rendering clips…';
    const videoSegNames = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < videoClips.length; i++) videoSegNames.push(await renderClipSegment(ffmpeg, videoClips[i], i, 'video', log));
    const audioSegNames = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < audioClips.length; i++) audioSegNames.push(await renderClipSegment(ffmpeg, audioClips[i], i, 'audio', log));

    let finalName;
    const gifMode = document.getElementById('gifExportEnabled').checked && videoSegNames.length > 0;
    if (videoSegNames.length > 0) {
      statusLine.innerText = 'Assembling video track…';
      let videoTrackOut = await concatVideoWithTransitions(ffmpeg, videoClips, videoSegNames, log);
      videoTrackOut = await applyTitlesPass(ffmpeg, videoTrackOut, log);

      if (gifMode) {
        const maxWidth = parseInt(document.getElementById('gifMaxWidth').value) || 480;
        const fps = parseInt(document.getElementById('gifFps').value) || 10;
        finalName = await convertToGif(ffmpeg, videoTrackOut, maxWidth, fps, log);
      } else if (audioSegNames.length > 0) {
        statusLine.innerText = 'Assembling audio track…';
        const audioTrackOut = await concatSegments(ffmpeg, audioSegNames, 'alist.txt', 'audio_track.m4a', log);
        const audioMode = document.getElementById('exportAudioMode').value;
        if (audioMode === 'mix') {
          statusLine.innerText = 'Mixing video audio with the audio track…';
          await ffmpeg.exec(['-i', videoTrackOut, '-i', audioTrackOut, '-filter_complex', '[0:a][1:a]amix=inputs=2:duration=longest:dropout_transition=0[aout]', '-map', '0:v:0', '-map', '[aout]', '-c:v', 'copy', '-c:a', 'aac', '-shortest', 'final.mp4']);
        } else {
          statusLine.innerText = "Muxing video with the audio track (replacing video's own audio)…";
          await ffmpeg.exec(['-i', videoTrackOut, '-i', audioTrackOut, '-map', '0:v:0', '-map', '1:a:0', '-c:v', 'copy', '-c:a', 'aac', '-shortest', 'final.mp4']);
        }
        finalName = 'final.mp4';
      } else {
        finalName = videoTrackOut === 'video_track.mp4' ? videoTrackOut : (await ffmpeg.exec(['-i', videoTrackOut, '-c', 'copy', 'final.mp4']), 'final.mp4');
      }
      if (!gifMode && document.getElementById('loudnormEnabled').checked) finalName = await applyLoudnorm(ffmpeg, finalName, true, log);
    } else {
      // audio-only project
      statusLine.innerText = 'Assembling audio…';
      finalName = await concatSegments(ffmpeg, audioSegNames, 'alist.txt', 'final.m4a', log);
      if (document.getElementById('loudnormEnabled').checked) finalName = await applyLoudnorm(ffmpeg, finalName, false, log);
    }

    statusLine.innerText = 'Reading result…';
    const data = await ffmpeg.readFile(finalName);
    const mime = finalName.endsWith('.m4a') ? 'audio/mp4' : finalName.endsWith('.gif') ? 'image/gif' : 'video/mp4';
    const blob = new Blob([data.buffer], { type: mime });
    if (lastExportObjectURL) URL.revokeObjectURL(lastExportObjectURL); // in case export was re-run this session
    lastExportObjectURL = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.getElementById('exportDownloadLink');
    link.href = lastExportObjectURL;
    link.download = finalName.endsWith('.m4a') ? 'export.m4a' : finalName.endsWith('.gif') ? 'export.gif' : 'export.mp4';

    document.getElementById('exportRunning').classList.add('hidden');
    document.getElementById('exportDone').classList.remove('hidden');
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(err);
    statusLine.innerText = 'Export failed — see the log below.';
    log(String(err && err.message ? err.message : err));
  } finally {
    document.getElementById('exportStartBtn').disabled = false;
  }
}

/* =========================================================================
   INIT
   ========================================================================= */
window.onload = async () => {
  await initDB();
  const saved = await loadMeta('appState').catch(() => undefined);
  if (saved && ((saved.assets && saved.assets.length) || (saved.timeline && ((saved.timeline.video || []).length || (saved.timeline.audio || []).length)))) {
    appState = Object.assign(
      { presets: [], markers: [], titles: [], playheadTime: 0, selectedClipId: null, selectedClipType: null,
        settings: { idealVolume: 0.7, zoomLevel: 10, audioVisMode: 'waveform', storyboardMode: false } },
      saved
    );
  }
  renderAssets(); renderTimeline(); renderPresetList(); renderTitleList();
  document.getElementById('zoomSlider').value = appState.settings.zoomLevel;
  document.getElementById('idealVolumeSlider').value = appState.settings.idealVolume;
  document.getElementById('idealVolLabel').innerText = appState.settings.idealVolume.toFixed(2);
  updateViewMenuState();
  updateScopeHint();
};
</script>
